collections.duplicate_evidence_policy: Annual tables, talks and later papers may repeat a result. Shared test images create dependence, while distinct later submissions are not automatically duplicate evaluations.

acceptance_tests: CI uses self-authored synthetic scores only and explicitly marks their provenance synthetic.
Private acceptance separately checks the exact compressed SHA-256/16,071 bytes, 113,529 decompressed bytes, 2,584 rows/17 metric labels and type counts; no full output is published.
Bound compressed bytes and decompression incrementally before exceeding maximum memory/work; reject malformed, truncated, CRC-invalid, concatenated and trailing gzip payloads.
Validate exactly six fields, finite bounded decimal strings, bounded lines/rows/fields and unique four-field keys.
Preserve exact score strings without binary-float round-trip, metric spelling/case and raw labels including cz-en, xx-en, en-hu, es-de and nc-test2008.
Preserve source-specific higher-is-better direction; never reverse mter again or make Rank ordinal.
Accept finite native metric values above one without a uniform percentage or [0,1] constraint.
Keep denominator, uncertainty, exact execution, first publication, archive capture and anonymized identities unknown.
Separate workshop day, paper month, explicitly supplied HTTP transport evidence and local read time; filesystem/gzip-header mtime establishes neither first publication nor execution.
Use artifact-and-edition/task-scoped review identities; rows/metrics are not independent experiments or globally resolved system identities.
Reject symlink/nonregular/network-style input and source hash drift; unsupported safe-open platform fails closed.
Keep the real gzip license unknown and reject admission, network collection, source-body vendoring and canonical import claims.
